title: Granularity from bounded Fourier support
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$, let $f:V\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $S$ be a natural number with $2\le S$. If at most $S$ dual Fourier coefficients of the real-valued function associated to $f$ are nonzero, then every dual Fourier coefficient is an integer multiple of $2(1/2)^{\lfloor\log_2 S\rfloor}$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-dimensional vector space $V$ over $\mathbb F_2$ with its finite additive group
Dual Fourier support has cardinality at most $S$
